documents.title: 48 CFR part 970 (Department of Energy Acquisition Regulation)

quotes.text: DOE has negotiated technology transfer clauses with the contractors managing and operating its laboratories.

The contracts are totally financed by DOE advance payments

quotes.text: The Energy Department's 17 National Labs
NETL is government-owned and government-operated (GOGO)

documents.title: 48 CFR part 970 (Department of Energy Acquisition Regulation)

quotes.text: DOE has negotiated technology transfer clauses with the contractors managing and operating its laboratories.
Employees of a management and operating contractor are entitled to the same rights and privileges with respect to outside employment as other citizens.

Generally, the compensation paid individual employees should be left to the judgment of contractors subject to the limitations of DOE-approved compensation policies, programs, classification systems, and schedules
The contracts are totally financed by DOE advance payments

exec-dept-doe-slac-national-accelerator-.headline: Not on a federal pay schedule: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is one of the 16 DOE laboratories operated by a contractor (DOE, NETL page, May 22, 2023).
exec-dept-doe-slac-national-accelerator-.notEstablished: No document here names who holds this post or says every holder is the contractor's employee, and the title is a template every DOE laboratory node carries. 'Not on a federal pay schedule' means not paid as a federal employee on a federal pay schedule; the money is DOE's, through the contract.
